cohort: A total of 2,917 asymptomatic patients in New York State who underwent cervical computed tomography (CT) scans at an emergency department of a level I trauma center during a one-year period.
finding: The prevalence of KFS was 0.0058% (1 in 172), with the most commonly fused levels being C5-C6 and C2-C3, and all identified cases classified as Samartzis type I.
